content.short: Stabil Finance compounds yield across HyperEVM lending, liquidity and staking positions.
content.description: Stabil Finance automates compounding across lending, liquidity provision and staking on HyperEVM, turning raw advertised rates into realised returns by reinvesting on a schedule. Manual compounding is where most of the theoretical yield in DeFi quietly goes missing, particularly on positions too small to justify the gas.
content.meta: Automated compounding that turns advertised HyperEVM rates into realised returns.
